reddit.title: Exciting Water Mechanics Update in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the water mechanics in Provincia! With our new native sparse flow system, water depth now updates efficiently without freezing your frame rate. You can shape the terrain without the water lagging behind. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Mechanics in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to announce a major update to the water system in Provincia! Our new native sparse flow mechanics ensure that water depth updates in real-time as you modify the terrain, enhancing your building experience. No more freezing frames when you interact with water! Read more about it here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
